2026-07-10 Korea

Korea Day 7

Breakfast

My last Açaíberry Yogurt Frappe :(.

Workshop

I was very excited for this workshop on AI for math research! Below is one of the talks.

Lunch

I guess I'm getting ready for China? Had some Hong Kong dim sum while talking to Rachel :).

Debate

Interesting Debate on whether we should keep humans around for research... It was an anti-debate, so the goal was to discuss opposing ideas but ultimately help bring each other come closer to a middle ground. TDLR: the number of researchers will inevitably decrease, but we will still need human guidance/sovereigty. Researchers will move to more applied fields to enhance research in more "hard"-sciences. I somewhat agree with this opinion but reach out to me if you want to discuss more.

Bye ICML

It was fun, but time for the next adventure.

Airport

After a 1-hour delay of my bus, I was slightly concerned 2 hour wasn't going to be enough to go through security or any checks given this was my first time going to China. Thankfully I was through security within an hour. With little time to board, I went for the "best" option near my gate - an Italian restaurant. I got a "seafood" pasta. Lets just say you shouldn't get Italian food at this Korean Aiport. Only clams (when shirmp and squid were also advertized), extremely cheap pasta on a watery tomato base, spicy but with little flavor. Their lemonade was awful too :(.

So fun they have this for families!

China

Landed on China for the International Math Olympiad (IMO). Brought so many memories of being a contestant.
